scope: Pre-publication verification of the consolidated two-robot laboratory
browserObserved: Both current models render together; common viewpoints and motion controls are available
Seven assemblies per model; isolation and restoration preserve the selected tool
Model selection, tool switching, archive pose restoration and passports work
A 390 CSS-pixel iframe renders stacked comparison panes without horizontal overflow
Both downloadable ZIP files are assembled and pass full SHA-256 verification in the browser
Offline save reports both models, passports and ten photographs saved
limitations: The narrow viewport check is not a physical-phone test
No physical VR headset was tested during this consolidation
Collision checks cover only the documented pairs and poses, not every possible configuration
The Blender source archive belongs to an earlier research stage and is not an export of v7/v23
Publication and GitHub Actions results must be checked separately for the release commit
